statement: Under the FinCEN beneficial-ownership regulation as amended by the March 2025 interim final rule, only entities formed under the law of a foreign country and registered to do business in a US state or tribal jurisdiction are reporting companies; entities created by filing with a secretary of state (domestic corporations and LLCs) are exempt from BOI reporting, and a foreign reporting company registering on or after March 26, 2025 files within 30 calendar days (31 CFR § 1010.380(c)(1)(ii), (c)(2)(xxiv), (a)(1)).
caveat: This reverses the pre-2025 rule that covered domestic companies, and further rulemaking or litigation could change it again; verify the live regulation and FinCEN guidance before relying. This repo does not determine reporting-company status.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
